name: kebab-mcp
description: Personal MCP server framework — deploy your AI backend to Vercel in 5 minutes. 86+ tools, 16 connectors. One endpoint for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, ChatGPT.

paragraphs: Your personal AI backend. One endpoint. 97+ tools. Deploy in 5 minutes.
A few prompts to give you the shape of what's possible:
features: Five families of capability. Each connector auto-activates when its credentials are in your env.

Google Workspace, Obsidian Vault, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Linear, Airtable, Browser Automation, Apify (LinkedIn reads), Unipile (LinkedIn + WhatsApp), Composio (1000+ apps via bridge), Paywall Readers, Webhooks. 97+…

API Connections turns any HTTP endpoint into an MCP tool — paste an OpenAPI spec or wire a REST endpoint, define the auth, ship. No code, no PR. Useful for internal APIs, niche SaaS, or quick experiments.

Skills are user-defined tools built from prompt templates. Compose existing tools in the dashboard's visual wizard, save, and the skill becomes skill in your MCP client. Versioned — every edit is a new revision, with…

Unified /config page covers connector status, per-tool toggles, live logs, deep health checks, OAuth flows, Skill composer, API playground, and one-click upstream updates. The Welcome wizard handles first-run token…
